8174.title: Unnecessary core initialization during plugin dispatch
8174.rootCauseOneLine: CLI startup imports and registers all core groups and JSON help before attempting plugin dispatch, even though the successful proxy exits without using them.

prReviews.verdict: Addresses cause statically; not runtime verified
prReviews.topFinding: Moves plugin dispatch ahead of core initialization; reviewed only as untrusted metadata and diff, never checked out or run.

8174.proposedFix: Dispatch owned plugin commands before importing core groups, preserving unknown-command and soft-alias fallbacks. No duplicate PR: open #8175 already closes the issue.
8174.caveats: Two clean trusted-main reproductions by the same agent. Exact CPU/wall-time savings and PR-branch behavior were not measured. Existing startup suite passes all 8 tests.
